scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors
scenarios.reasoning: Efficient, methodical binlog analysis with counts per TFM and per-task node, verified the project file lacked TFM conditions, and delivered a precise root cause plus actionable fix. Minor slip: one FS0072 count line said 4 in a search but 63 elsewhere (the 4 was FS0193), and a couple of ambiguous 'under($project net472)' queries returned 169 without being questioned — but the conclusions were correctly verified by other means.

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized FS0039 errors occur only on net472
Identified undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime APIs
